notes.title: Hidden Dragon: Legend New Mode Update
notes.content:
Dear all,

Sincere thanks for all your support! We've added a new Challenge Mode to the game. Please see below for the details. Hope you will enjoy!

1) New Challenge Mode

This is an entirely new mode, separate from level progress. Even newcomers can challenge this mode right away. 

In this mode, Players will start from the prologue, and challenge all game bosses in sequence. After the defeat of each boss, a Buff will be received, right up until the final Boss is defeated (Zhou Zong). In this mode, all battle times will be recorded, and displayed in the rankings after completion. 

Things to look out for in this mode：

Uses an independent balance system；
The players skills, weapons, combos and sutras are completely unlocked；
Each level will automatically return potion use to the upper limit；
Careful selection of Buffs can decrease level times.

Whose strategy is the greatest? Who will be the fastest? Whose side will luck fall? Join in to find out! 

2) Additional Info

Some levels have received improvements
Many Bugs have been fixed

notes.title: Hidden Dragon: Legend Fourth Patch Update
notes.content:
Dear all,

We just added another patch. In this patch, you will see the following changes.

a.	Add a Hit Stop button under Settings—Interface. Players can turn Hit Stop on and off under Settings—Interface. 

b.	Changed the calculation method of flame damage dealt to players. 

c.	Allow players to skip any animation from the start of the game. 

d.	Bug fixes
  1)	 Fixed the bug where players cannot move after respawning from death against the destroyer.
  2)	 Fixed the bug where the question of covering a saved data will pop up after the players is loading a saved data.
  3)	 Fixed the bug where blood effects will follow the movements of an enemy after getting hit.
  4)	 Fixed the bug in Weapon UI interface where the English and Japanese version do not show refining level.
  5)	 Fixed the bug in dagger tutorial where players have a small probability of not obtaining the dagger.
  6)	 Fixed the bug where enemies AI cannot enter the battle under certain low fps circumstances.
  7)	 Fixed the bug where players cannot inherit the refining level after obtaining a new weapon “soul”.
  8)	 Fixed the bug when the player equips Bloodthirst Skill Sutra, attack of Destroyer on Cleavers will heal the player.
  9)	 Fixed the hidden map of Chapter 4-- Heart of the Hidden City.

Thanks for all the feedback. Keep it coming! Now please enjoy!

notes.title: Hidden Dragon: Legend Third Patch Update
notes.content:
Dear all,

Welcome to the third patch! In the third patch, you will see the following changes.

1) Adjust the proportion of character growth numeral. 
After collect many players feedbacks and to optimize the difficulty experience curve, we decide to adjust part of the numeral growth of “Sutra Upgrade” and ” Weapon Refining” in order to bring all players a more smooth game experience. The promotion of these two will bring you much better growth bonus.

2) Adjust the output of Blue-soul. 
The output of Blue-soul will be promoted in the hard mode.

3) The cutscene could be skipped by pressing ESC or controller’s button B even for the first time.
Except for some special scene.

4) Adjust shadow spear’s skill - “Smog”: 
Change “Smog will be eliminated by attack” into “Smog will disappear directly when smog time is over”

5) Optimize the display of equip or not equip the Sutra.

6) Add new language: 
English and Japanese. Add the voice option.

7) Optimize the game experience of some skills will cause acute shaking in 60FPS mode.

8) Fixed some bugs:
a. Fixed the situation of players may be stuck by the elevator sometimes in “Taiyuan Tower Foot” stage.
b. Fixed the situation of players may be extruded out of the world by the elevator sometimes in “Secret Weapon” stage.
c. Fixed the situation of the stage cannot continue after using the resurgence item if the player and boss died at the same time.

Now please enjoy!

notes.content:
Dear all, sincere thanks for your continued feedback! We've updated the game to enhance your gaming experience. Please see below for the specific changes.

For example: Deal extra damage to puppet enemies. Those hints will also be displayed on weapon interface.

2) Fixed the bug in chapter two where players cannot activate achievements.

Hoping that all of you will enjoy the game!  Thanks again for your support!

notes.title: Message from the Developer
notes.content:
We are an indie game developer team from China. Hidden Dragon is a console game that we spent three years developing and has won awards such as “Best Technology” at China IndiePlay 2015 and “Outstanding Game Award” at China IndiePlay 2016. Set in Imperial China, Hidden Dragon Legend is an action adventure game with hardcore gameplay. We utilized the 3D side-scrolling perspective of the game to combine classic platform action with fast-paced combo fighting, bringing players a unique visual experience with stunning scenery. At the same time, because the storyline has a dark theme that revolves around revenge, we used cooler hues for the overall color scheme. 

Due to a limited budget, we were unable to develop the cinematics and storyline to an AAA game standard which is something we are regretful about. Since the release of the console version, we have spent around half a year upgrading the gaming experience and we hope that our Steam players will enjoy the game as much as we enjoyed developing it.

- Megafun Games

notes.title: Hidden Dragon Legend - A Warrior's Vengeance
notes.content:
http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31439109/6a10e5155c6341cc6d02376a1469d98abd7a3db9.png

Treachery, betrayal, and emptiness are the only feelings left for Master Lu after waking up on a living nightmare. In search for truth and revenge, he needs to fight the evil factions, the secret organization YAO. Released for Playstation 4 last August, this 2.5D robust action platformer is a game for hardcore action Metroidvania fans. It will be launched on Steam on January 22, 2018. 

New Features of the game includes:

1.	Max frame rate increased to 60fps

2.	Keyboard support

3.	More options for graphics and sound settings

4.	New animations at the beginning and end of each level

5.	Falling off cliffs no longer causes death but instead the player is teleported to the last save point 

6.	More QTEs during cut scenes

7.	New achievements when accomplishing QTEs successfully

8.	Soul Currency update: Green soul to be used to purchase HP restoration items while Red souls are used to purchase upgrading items

9.	New Resurrection mode. Players now have an option to use medicine and revive on the spot rather than starting from the last save point.

10.	More combos available on early levels

11.	Updated tutorial


Check out the game in the store and follow Master Lu on his path for revenge.
